description: New run_job orchestrator with a coroutine called without await and a check-then-create race, plus two precision baits.

seeded_bugs.why: cleanup_temp(tmp) creates a coroutine that is never awaited -- cleanup silently never runs (RuntimeWarning at best).
exists()-then-open('w') race: two workers processing the same job id both pass the check and the second silently overwrites. open(mode='x') with FileExistsError handling is the fix.

noise_traps.must_not: be flagged as a performance issue -- TAGS is a 3-element literal tuple; the loop is bounded and cold
be flagged -- run_job lacking a docstring is taste, not a contract violation in this repo
